details:
- CVE-2026-53785: create a transfer's implied parent directories and the
  generator's directory entries through the symlink-race-safe parent walk, so
  a symlink planted at a parent component cannot make a non-chrooted receiver
  create them outside the destination tree
- CVE-2026-53783: complete the els3 fix, which was partial: add --confine-root
  so a restricted-directory server also refuses the names that arrive over the
  protocol (file-list names, --files-from lines, filter merge files), and have
  rrsync pass it; hand rsync a pinned receiver directory option and an existing
  directory destination as /proc/self/fd/N/. and any other existing destination
  as its pinned parent plus the leaf, so --partial-dir no longer discards
  completed files and a push onto an existing file no longer fails
